name: Air Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official product page describes the air heat exchanger as the main equipment used in devices that cool or heat air with hot and cold media. It can heat air with high-temperature water, steam, or high-temperature heat transfer oil, and cool air with brine or low-temperature water. ViEX highlights finned tubes as the core heat transfer component and states the product is especially suitable for hot air heating, air conditioning, cooling, condensation, dehumidification, and drying applications in environments with limited water sources.
advantage: Suitable for heating or cooling air with multiple media
High heat exchange efficiency from finned tube structure
Small thermal resistance and high strength
Designed for reliable long-term cold and hot duty

technical_parameters.Fin materials: Aluminum alloy; Copper; Carbon steel; Stainless steel
technical_parameters.Finned tube types: Wound L type; Bimetal rolled DR type; Embedded G type; Welded type
technical_parameters.Base tube materials: Carbon steel; Copper; Titanium; Stainless steel

details.title: What does the product do?
details.content: It is used as the main heat exchange equipment for cooling or heating air, including hot air heating, air conditioning, cooling, condensation, dehumidification, and drying applications.

details.title: What design points does ViEX emphasize?
details.content: The page emphasizes finned tubes, especially commonly used DR type bimetal rolled tubes, along with compact structure, large heat transfer area per unit volume, and reliable long-term anti-corrosion performance.

seo_data.meta_description: Finned-tube air heat exchanger for heating, cooling, condensation, dehumidification, and drying duties across industrial applications.
